name: Levelers
description: Constructs that come every 100 cycles to kill the greatest warrior in the Tangle.

description_citations.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raksha Golden Cub praises the skyhunters who raise the alarm against levelers.
timeline.quote: They are the first to raise the alarm when the levelers attack, and the first to risk their lives to defend the pride.

citation.text: Skyhunter Patrol (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa begins her story, setting out to find out why the levelers seek to destroy her, which starts to uncover the mysteries of Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: begins her story to find out why the monstrous "levelers" seek to destroy her

citation.text: "Mirrodin", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad flees after a failed invention and finds the levelers' cavern.
timeline.quote: Slobad decided it was best to flee before any punishment could be forthcoming

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aerophin and thousands of Levelers attack; Glissa destroys the aerophin and Lyese reluctantly saves her sister's life.
timeline.quote: Lyese, having woken up and not willing to lose more family, reluctantly saves her sister's life.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Reunion with Bruenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Levelers kill Glissa's parents and sister; green flame erupts from Glissa and she is dragged away.
timeline.quote: she finds they have killed her parents and sister.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Glissa's vision". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Constructs that rip through Mirrodin once a century, obeying an unseen master.

citation.text: Mirrodin: card flavor text (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
